relations: Q-in closing begins exactly when Q-out opening begins

source_lineage.old_controller_requires_upper_body: It directly dereferences inclined-upper; do not call it unchanged on a no-upper map. Any adapted controller needs a new declaration.

relations.footprint_release: lower laser starts280/560 and ends at y230; span changes slope. Release when x=finiteEnd−lead, not after endpoint bypass.
relations.closing: close begins release+.1; duration=1.5*(wholeRadiusTail−closeStart), leaving exactly1/3 of320px gap at tail
relations.recovery: world ends240px after gate right edge, retaining230px after full-radius tail; no arbitrary terminal trimming
relations.finite_scope: beam is one width10 fixed-direction capsule translated vertically by native sineA20/P6, never rotated/tracked
relations.active_band: overlap uses full-radius lower halfplane and gate top; optional upper adds a conservative halfplane only if its expanded x extent reaches the receiver. Monotone line+sine extrema are endpoint-exact for this band.
relations.descent_scope: pre-release above-lower-branch upper bound compared with actual gate-right-edge lower bound; not a global unique-route or reachable-flight claim

inclined-lower.mechanical: live lower capsule bounds the above-beam branch, then real cooldown releases crossing space
inclined-lower.visual: one visible rising edge, less enclosed than the source channel

wide-receiving-cavity.mechanical: closing full-width aperture receives a lower posture and persists through full tail
wide-receiving-cavity.visual: one shared cavity makes the release/reception location legible

inclined-upper.mechanical: adds a real early upper collision boundary; late gate top can dominate it. Shortening/removal changes branch access.
inclined-upper.visual: paired parallel rails give channel identity and rhythm; losing them is a real design cost even if a tape could pass

ceiling-fold.mechanical: long fold can constrain entry side; short fold leaves an above-tip alternative. Not automatically redundant.
ceiling-fold.visual: a distinct entrance turn prepares the rising phrase

optional_upper_branch.kernel: with both rails removed, high preparation before the incline is available as a geometric alternative; it need not trace the lower edge
optional_upper_branch.short_rail_or_fold: a short upper rail can end before the gate, and a short fold can leave an above-tip route; actual reachability/control cost remains unknown
optional_upper_branch.full_source: full ceiling fold/full upper rail can block that early high route, so do not promise identical bypass for all masks
optional_upper_branch.limits: the gate still needs real entry and full-tail receipt; an optional high branch is not proof that every phase can be ignored

provider_metadata.readability_cost: minimum kernel may retain the action relation while losing the original channel enclosure and entry rhythm; visual value must be reviewed independently of collision removability
provider_metadata.input_question: Can two actual bodies preserve a readable rise, an interior lower-capsule crossing during real cooldown, and a closing-gate full-tail receipt from the declared entry?

preview_contract.rule: show actual finite lower beam and real gate aperture; warning beam is nonlethal, gate warning stays solid. Endpoint/cooldown cues must remain distinguishable.

risks: no new input or trajectory is inherited by removing bodies
earlier high preparation may weaken following-the-incline gameplay while remaining valid
compact steeper slope can change flap timing despite preserved late band relation
old controller relies on removed upper rail
losing channel identity can be a cost even with a pass

limitations: Masks none/upper/fold/both change real early-route collision boundaries and potentially visual enclosure; local redundancy does not make a rail globally cosmetic or prove the best appearance.
Native finite lower laser, true cooldown, full gate tail, lethal gate warning and future cycles remain. Numeric/conditional branch admission is not a physically safe parameter range.
